Keywords: cell counting bacterial concentration, bacterial concentration, cell counting, spectrophotometer, concentration, light
scattering, quickest method at the lab bench, cell, turbidity
Abstract
Bacterial concentration can be measured by several methods. One of them is turbidity. Turbidity, or light
scattering, is measured in a spectrophotometer such as a Spectronic 20. This method has the advantage of being
the quickest method at the lab bench.
Materials
Reagents
Turbid broth culture of E. coli
Tryptic soy broth (TSB)
Lab equipment
21 clean culture tubes (they do not need to be sterile)
Clean spectrophotometer cuvettes
10-1000 ml pipets
Pipump
Vortex mixer
Safety warnings
Please note: Be sure to wear gloves during this procedure, to avoid getting culture on your hands while
transferring liquid from tubes. Lab coat is also required.
Before start
Check all working surfaces and materials are clean before start
protocols.io | https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ajhscn
October 16, 2019
2/4

Making an absorbance curve for Escherichia coli
1
Turn on the spectrophotometer and set the wavelength to 425 nm. Let it warm up for at
least 15 min.
2
Label the culture tubes 1 – 21. Using different pipets, add turbid E. coli culture and TSB to
each tube in the volumes shown in the table.
3
Mix each tube thoroughly by vortexing for 1 – 2 sec with a vortex mixer.
4
With no tube in the spectrophotometer, set the 0%T setting.
protocols.io | https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ajhscn
October 16, 2019
3/4

5
Transfer 3 – 4 ml of broth from tube 21 (TSB with no E. coli) to the spectrophotometer
cuvette, carefully wipe the outside of the tube with a kimwipe, place the tube in the
machine, and set the 100%T setting (blank the spectrophotometer). Switch the
spectrophotometer setting to “Absorbance.”
6
Remove the cuvette and pour the broth back into tube 21. Carefully drain the last few
drops from the lip of the cuvette into a kimwipe. Put the contaminated kimwipe in the
biohazard bag.
7
Starting with tube #20 and going backwards to tube #1, repeat steps 5-6. 
8
Transfer the data to a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet. The spreadsheet should contain the
following columns: volume of E. coli culture, volume of broth, dilution factor, and
measured absorbance.
9
In the spreadsheet, create an X-Y scatter plot of dilution factor vs absorbance. 
* Please note: All charts must be added as separate sheets in the workbook, not pasted
into the worksheet with the data columns. 
10
Add a second order polynomial trendline to the plot, and set the options on the trendline
to show the equation and the correlation coefficient.
11
From the plot, identify the range in which absorbance is proportional to bacterial
concentration. Create a second plot, plotting only the linear range of dilution factor vs
absorbance.
12
Add a linear trendline to the second plot, and set the options for the trendline to show the
equation and the correlation coefficient.

translation_zh.title: 细胞计数（大肠杆菌吸光度标准曲线的绘制）
translation_zh.abstract_zh: 通过分光光度法测定一系列稀释度的大肠杆菌培养物吸光度，绘制标准曲线并确定吸光度与菌浓度成正比的线性范围。

steps.text_zh: 打开分光光度计，将波长设置为 425 nm。预热至少 15 min。
steps.source_text: Turn on the spectrophotometer and set the wavelength to 425 nm. Let it warm up for at least 15 min.

steps.text_zh: 将培养管编号为 1 – 21。使用不同的移液器，按表中给出的体积向各管加入浑浊的大肠杆菌培养液和 TSB（胰酪大豆胨肉汤）。
steps.source_text: Label the culture tubes 1 - 21. Using different pipets, add turbid E. coli culture and TSB to each tube in the volumes shown in the table.

steps.text_zh: 用涡旋混合器将每管涡旋 1 – 2 sec，充分混匀。
steps.source_text: Mix each tube thoroughly by vortexing for 1 - 2 sec with a vortex mixer.

steps.text_zh: 分光光度计中不放任何比色管，设定 0%T。
steps.source_text: With no tube in the spectrophotometer, set the 0%T setting.

steps.text_zh: 从 21 号管（不含大肠杆菌的 TSB）中取 3 – 4 ml 培养基转入比色皿，用 Kimwipe 无尘纸小心擦拭管外壁，放入仪器，设定 100%T（对分光光度计调空白）。随后将仪器切换到 Absorbance（吸光度）模式。
steps.source_text: Transfer 3 - 4 ml of broth from tube 21 (TSB with no E. coli) to the spectrophotometer cuvette, carefully wipe the outside of the tube with a kimwipe, place the tube in the machine, and set the 100%T setting (blank the spectrophotometer). Switch the spectrophotometer setting to Absorbance.

steps.text_zh: 取出比色皿，将培养基倒回 21 号管。小心地把比色皿口沿残留的最后几滴液体沥到 Kimwipe 无尘纸上。将被污染的无尘纸投入生物危害废弃物袋。
steps.source_text: Remove the cuvette and pour the broth back into tube 21. Carefully drain the last few drops from the lip of the cuvette into a kimwipe. Put the contaminated kimwipe in the biohazard bag.

steps.text_zh: 从 20 号管开始，倒序测至 1 号管，重复步骤 5-6。
steps.source_text: Starting with tube #20 and going backwards to tube #1, repeat steps 5-6.

steps.text_zh: 将数据转入 Microsoft Excel 表格。表格应包含以下列：大肠杆菌培养液体积、培养基体积、稀释倍数、实测吸光度。
steps.source_text: Transfer the data to a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet. The spreadsheet should contain the following columns: volume of E. coli culture, volume of broth, dilution factor, and measured absorbance.

steps.text_zh: 在表格中制作稀释倍数对吸光度的 X-Y 散点图。注意：所有图表必须作为独立工作表添加到工作簿中，不得直接粘贴到含数据列的工作表内。
steps.source_text: In the spreadsheet, create an X-Y scatter plot of dilution factor vs absorbance. All charts must be added as separate sheets in the workbook.

steps.title_zh: 添加二次多项式趋势线
steps.text_zh: 为图表添加二阶多项式趋势线，并在趋势线选项中勾选显示方程和相关系数。
steps.source_text: Add a second order polynomial trendline to the plot, and set the options on the trendline to show the equation and the correlation coefficient.

steps.text_zh: 从图中找出吸光度与细菌浓度成正比的范围。仅用该线性范围的数据，绘制第二张稀释倍数对吸光度的图。
steps.source_text: From the plot, identify the range in which absorbance is proportional to bacterial concentration. Create a second plot, plotting only the linear range.

steps.text_zh: 为第二张图添加线性趋势线，并在趋势线选项中勾选显示方程和相关系数。
steps.source_text: Add a linear trendline to the second plot, and set the options for the trendline to show the equation and the correlation coefficient.
